| `book-god-original` | https://nupress.northwestern.edu/9780810128538/being-and-god/ | https://northwest-press-us.imgix.net/covers/9780810128538.jpg?auto=format&w=700 |
| `book-nothing-original` | https://www.bloomsbury.com/uk/being-and-nothing-9781350503465/ | https://res.cloudinary.com/bloomsbury-atlas/image/upload/w_568%2Cc_scale%2Cdpr_1.5/jackets/9781350503465.jpg |
